key.name: max-dictation-seconds
key.description: Seconds after which a dictation stops on its own and the transcription is inserted. A service that transcribes less than this at a stretch lowers it: with OpenRouter selected the preferences go no higher than ten minutes.

key.name: mistral-api-key
key.description: API key used to authenticate with Mistral's Voxtral transcription endpoints.

key.name: openrouter-api-key
key.description: API key used to authenticate with OpenRouter's speech-to-text endpoint.

key.name: openrouter-model
key.description: Which of the transcription models OpenRouter serves transcribes a dictation or a recording, written as the slug on its model page. The preferences list what OpenRouter currently offers; any slug it accepts can be set here.

key.name: remember-dictations
key.description: Whether the text of a finished dictation is kept on disk, as history.jsonl in the extension's own directory under XDG_STATE_HOME, to be read back and copied from the History page. A field the application reports as a password is never kept.

key.name: show-panel-on-start
key.summary: Show the panel when a dictation starts
key.description: Whether a dictation opens the panel, which then holds the keyboard so that Enter, Ctrl+Enter and Esc control it. When off, a dictation starts collapsed to the indicator in the top bar and nothing is drawn over your work.

key.name: silence-timeout-seconds
key.description: Seconds of uninterrupted silence that end a dictation. 0 keeps listening until stopped by hand.

key.name: toggle-dictation
key.description: Shortcut that opens the dictation panel, then stops and inserts the transcription.

key.name: toggle-recording
key.description: Shortcut that starts recording everything the computer plays and the microphone hears, then stops and transcribes it. The audio and the transcript are saved side by side in the Murmur folder in Documents.

key.name: transcription-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds of audio Voxtral buffers before transcribing a dictation. Higher values give the model more context and better accuracy, lower values show and insert text sooner.

key.name: transcription-provider
key.description: Which service transcribes your dictations and recordings. Each has its own API key.

key.name: typing-speed
key.description: Characters per second used to insert the transcription. Lower it if characters get dropped or reordered.

key.name: xai-api-key
key.description: API key used to authenticate with xAI's speech-to-text endpoints for Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0.
